title: Moore photographs documents in an upstate New York hotel room

tellings.quote: He had to go one time he was told in the middle of this he said go to this hotel room in upstate New York.

plain: In the early 1980s the UFO researcher Bill Moore was told to go to a hotel room in upstate New York, where, the story goes, he photographed documents he was being shown. The writer Greg Bishop tells this on the show, repeating what Moore himself said happened. It matters because it suggests someone was deliberately feeding Moore papers to spread.
